description:
The crew uncovers a stash of rare sports memorabilia, including a hockey stick autographed by Wayne Gretzky and an original skateboard from Tony Hawk. They also score signed NBA jerseys, a baseball autographed by Mickey Mantle, and other collectible items, turning old storage finds into a collector’s dream.
